GitHub topology and concrete attestation providers are dependent adapter work.",
  "non_goals": ["GitHub Environment/job topology, forge SDKs, Tokio, Rayon, caches, or generic persistence.", "Persisting raw endpoints, credentials, command lines, stderr, arbitrary error text, or miette reports.", "Silently importing legacy PublishReport as successful durable evidence.", "Changing prerelease lane semantics."],
  "api_surface": ["callisto-model: ReleasePackageId, ReleaseOperationId, ReleaseOperation, ReleaseInputSnapshotV1, ReleaseIntentV1, IntentDigest, ArtifactDigest, SemanticInputDigest, ReleaseExecutionStateV1, ReleaseReceiptV1, OperationState, OperationOutcome, ReconciledReleasePlanV1, SourceIdentity, ExecutionTrustProfileV1.", "ReleasePackageId and each digest are distinct private-field validated newtypes with fallible Deserialize.", "callisto-graph: opaque non-Serialize non-Clone ValidatedReleaseIntent; durable release mutation requires it and ApplyPermit."],
  "acceptance_criteria": [
    {"id":"AC-001","criterion":"callisto-model contains only serializable domain values and pure digest/canonicalization functions; it imports no AGPL workspace crate and never opens a workspace, resolves config, invokes Git, executes a command, or reads environment. callisto-graph builds snapshots, derives operations, validates live state, and owns ValidatedReleaseIntent. cargo metadata proves the Layer 1 dependency boundary.","is_error_case":false},
    {"id":"AC-002","criterion":"ReleasePackageId is opaque, ecosystem-qualified, and non-empty; constructor and Deserialize reject bare/malformed identities. ReleaseOperationId contains ReleasePackageId, explicit role, Version, and validated RegistryKey only for registry roles. Equality/ordering are structural and no release path invokes PackageId::matches. A cargo:shared success cannot satisfy npm:shared.","is_error_case":true},
    {"id":"AC-003","criterion":"Every ReleaseOperation contains sorted duplicate-free prerequisites. ReleaseOperationId ordering is lexicographic by ecosystem prefix, package name, role discriminator, rendered version, then registry key; prerequisite edges use that ordering; nodes use stable Kahn topological order with that comparator for ties. Intent conversion rejects duplicate operations, unknown/self/duplicate prerequisites, cycles, and any noncanonical node/edge order. Tag and forge-release prerequisites are explicit DAG edges, never inferred by reconciliation.","is_error_case":true},
    {"id":"AC-004","criterion":"ReleaseInputSnapshotV1 is the exhaustive versioned projection used for intent construction and validation: source identity; selected qualified packages, workspace-relative manifest paths, versions, roles and manifest/config fingerprints; effective release/publish policy; credential-free registry-key binding fingerprints; and every group, cascade, tag, and policy value that affects the DAG. Registry bindings reject URL userinfo, fragments, and query strings before fingerprinting; fingerprints are over normalized scheme, host, explicit port, and path only, never raw endpoints. It excludes credentials and raw endpoints. One graph snapshot builder serves construction and validation; tests mutate every declared category and prove rejection.","is_error_case":false},
    {"id":"AC-005","criterion":"SemanticInputDigest is SHA-256 over a versioned length-prefixed snapshot transcript; IntentDigest is SHA-256 over a distinct transcript of intent schema, snapshot, canonical DAG, and trust profile; ArtifactDigest is SHA-256 over exact artifact bytes. Newtypes accept only 64 lowercase hex. Fixed vectors prove ordering, bytes, roles, DAG edges, and lengths affect the required digest; no float is representable.","is_error_case":false},
    {"id":"AC-006","criterion":"Received v1 JSON crosses wire-DTO-to-domain conversion. Every nested v1 wire type uses deny_unknown_fields; conversion validates schema, newtypes, canonical order, uniqueness, and DAG invariants. State/receipt carry exact IntentDigest and schema; resume, receipt construction, and reconciliation reject mismatched intent before eligibility or mutation.","is_error_case":true},
    {"id":"AC-007","criterion":"Validation rebuilds snapshot and expected canonical DAG from one supplied Workspace, compares both exactly, and returns ValidatedReleaseIntent only on equality. It never calls plan_publish or plan_version and never executes a rebuilt graph. The capability is private-field, nonconstructible, non-Clone, and nonserializable; a compile-fail doctest and divergent fixture prove no forge/substitution.","is_error_case":true},
    {"id":"AC-008","criterion":"Operation states transition only Pending -> Attempting -> Published | AlreadySatisfied | Failed | Blocked. Executor atomically persists Attempting before every remote/VCS effect; terminal states never change or return to Pending. Restart observes Attempting with a deterministic role-specific equality predicate: registry operations require the intended registry key, qualified package, and version; tags require name, intended target commit, and annotation policy; forge releases require bound tag and target. Exact equality becomes AlreadySatisfied; a mismatched existing object becomes Blocked(ConflictingExistingOperation); conclusive absence becomes Blocked(IndeterminateAttempt); inconclusive observation remains Attempting and stops. Receipt rejects nonterminal state. Tests cover altered tag target, registry target, and forge-release binding.","is_error_case":true},
    {"id":"AC-009","criterion":"Pure reconciliation takes one exact intent and intent-bound state. A tag/forge release is eligible only after all transitive exact prerequisites are Published/AlreadySatisfied; no other, missing, unknown, or mismatched outcome is success. State uses atomic_write through a narrow receipt-store test seam with deterministic pre-rename failure injection; torn/failed writes never read as success.","is_error_case":true},
    {"id":"AC-010","criterion":"Intent has explicit GitCommit or HermeticContent trust profile. GitCommit requires detached/full HEAD equality to SourceIdentity, no tracked or untracked files except an explicit fixed ignored allowlist, and execution from that checked-out root. HermeticContent requires a declared closed input-root list and digest over every included byte; it never falls back to GitCommit. A workspace-scoped Callisto lock is acquired before final validation and held through receipt persistence. Immediately before each effect executor rechecks source, manifest/config fingerprints, effective policy, registry binding, and exact operation preconditions, then uses only prepared validated inputs; any difference persists Blocked(StaleValidation) and performs no mutation. Durable failures contain only closed discriminators/safe fixed fields; credentials, credential-shaped URLs, supplied secrets, and stderr are never persisted. #[derive(Clone, Debug, thiserror::Error, miette::Diagnostic, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum ConfigError {
    #[error("failed to read `{path}`: {message}")]
    #[diagnostic(code(E110))]
    Read { path: PathBuf, message: String },

    #[error("`{path}` is not valid TOML: {message}")]
    #[diagnostic(code(E111), help("Verify callisto.toml TOML syntax formatting."))]
    ParseToml { path: PathBuf, message: String },

    #[error("[[package-set]] `{pattern}` matched no packages")]
    PackageSetMatchedNothing { pattern: String },

    #[error("[[package]] `{pattern}` matched no package")]
    PackageMatchedNothing { pattern: String },

    #[error("package `{package}` is claimed by more than one [[package-set]]: {}", .patterns.join(", "))]
    OverlappingPackageSets { package: String, patterns: Vec<String> },

    #[error("group `{group}` and group `{other}` both list `{member}`")]
    ConflictingGroupNames {
        group: GroupName,
        other: GroupName,
        member: String,
    },

    #[error("group `{group}` has no members")]
    EmptyGroup { group: GroupName },

    #[error("duplicate group name `{group}`")]
    DuplicateGroupName { group: GroupName },

    #[error("`publish-to` names registry key `{key}`, which no [registries.*] block defines")]
    UnknownRegistry { key: String },

    #[error("`{path}` sets unknown callisto key `{key}`")]
    UnknownKey { path: PathBuf, key: String },

    #[error("`cascade.bump-severity` is `{found}`; expected `patch` or `minor`")]
    InvalidBumpSeverity { found: String },

    #[error("`pre-major-inference` is `{found}`; expected `off`, `conservative`, or `conservative-feat`")]
    InvalidPreMajorInference { found: String },

    #[error(
        "changesets.dir `{dir}` is an absolute path or contains `..` path components and would escape the workspace root"
    )]
    #[diagnostic(
        code(E116),
        help("Use a forward-slash-separated path relative to the workspace root that is not absolute and does not contain '..' components.")
    )]
    InvalidChangesetsDir { dir: String },

    #[error("`changelog = \"{value}\"` on `{pattern}` is an absolute path or contains `..` path components and would escape the workspace root")]
    #[diagnostic(
        code(E113),
        help("Use a forward-slash-separated path relative to the package root that does not contain '..' components.")
    )]
    InvalidChangelogPath { pattern: String, value: String },

    #[error(transparent)]
    Tag(#[from] TagTemplateError),

    #[error(transparent)]
    VersionParse(#[from] VersionParseError),
}

content.text:
Graph implementation ownership was consolidated with the parallel validation agent to avoid competing modules. I removed my overlapping uncommitted graph code and reviewed the retained implementation.

I caught and had corrected the key source-substitution flaw: validation now re-observes workspace `HEAD` for the Git profile rather than trusting the source identity embedded in received JSON. It also rejects HermeticContent validation until a proper closed-root verifier exists.

One remaining design note: replace semicolon/`Debug`-string snapshot assembly with explicit length-prefixed transcript fields before declaring AC-004 fully satisfied.
